rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for things that are chaotic, disorganized, or inconsistent.

example.english: Your room is really haphazard, with clothes scattered everywhere.
example.traditional: 你間房真係亂七八糟，啲衫周圍都係。
example.jyutping: nei5 gaan1 fong4 zan1 hai6 lyun6 cat1 baat3 zou1 di1 saam1 zau1 wai4 dou1 hai6

rows.note: Use this when the haphazard quality comes from being careless, casual, or insufficiently thorough.

example.english: Your homework is so haphazard; how would the teacher accept it?
example.traditional: 你份功課做得咁求其，老師點會收貨呀？
example.jyutping: nei5 fan6 gung1 fo3 zou6 dak1 gam3 kau4 kei4 lou5 si1 dim2 wui5 sau1 fo3 aa3

rows.note: Use this pattern when emphasizing that something was done or changed randomly without a plan.

example.english: They changed the document in a haphazard way, making it even messier.
example.traditional: 佢亂咁改嘅，搞到份文件更加亂。
example.jyutping: keoi5 lyun6 gam3 goi2 ge3 gaau2 dou3 fan6 man4 gin6 gang3 gaa1 lyun6
